---
title: "Temporary Standardised Residual Maps"
subtitle: "Model estimates compared with direct estimates"
---

This temporary workbook gathers the existing direct, FH, BHF, and MRP outputs and computes standardised residuals in one place. These residuals compare each model estimate with the corresponding direct survey estimate, so they are useful diagnostics rather than ground-truth validation.

```{r}
#| label: setup-standardised-residual-maps
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(stringr)
library(tidyr)
library(sf)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(scales)

base_path <- if (dir.exists("data")) {
  normalizePath("data")
} else {
  normalizePath(file.path("..", "data"))
}
share_label <- label_percent(accuracy = 0.1)
residual_label <- label_number(accuracy = 0.1)
missing_fill <- "grey85"

msoa_boundaries <- st_read(
  file.path(base_path, "boundaries-msoa.geojson"),
  quiet = TRUE
) |>
  rename(area_id = all_of("MSOA21CD")) |>
  filter(str_starts(area_id, "W"))

map_text_theme <- theme(
  plot.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
  axis.title.y = element_text(
    size = 12,
    face = "bold",
    angle = 90,
    margin = margin(r = 15)
  ),
  legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
  legend.text = element_text(size = 9)
)

map_annotation_theme <- theme(
  plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
  plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0.5, colour = "grey30")
)
```

```{r}
#| label: import-method-estimates

direct_estimates <- read_csv(
  file.path(base_path, "freqwalk_estimates_direct.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) |>
  select(area_id, time_id, msoa_name, direct_estimate, variance, n)

read_method_estimates <- function(path, method_name, estimate_col, variance_col) {
  read_csv(path, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
    transmute(
      method = method_name,
      area_id,
      time_id,
      model_estimate = .data[[estimate_col]],
      model_variance = .data[[variance_col]]
    )
}

method_estimates <- bind_rows(
  read_method_estimates(
    file.path(base_path, "freqwalk_estimates_fh.csv"),
    "FH",
    "fh_estimate",
    "fh_variance"
  ),
  read_method_estimates(
    file.path(base_path, "freqwalk_estimates_bhf.csv"),
    "BHF",
    "bhf_estimate",
    "bhf_variance"
  ),
  read_method_estimates(
    file.path(base_path, "freqwalk_estimates_mrp.csv"),
    "MRP",
    "mrp_estimate",
    "mrp_variance"
  )
)

standardised_residuals <- method_estimates |>
  left_join(direct_estimates, by = c("area_id", "time_id")) |>
  mutate(
    method = factor(method, levels = c("FH", "BHF", "MRP")),
    std_resid = (direct_estimate - model_estimate) /
      sqrt(variance + model_variance),
    abs_std_resid = abs(std_resid)
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: summarise-standardised-residuals

standardised_residuals |>
  group_by(method) |>
  summarise(
    area_time_cells = n(),
    mean_abs_std_resid = mean(abs_std_resid, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_abs_std_resid = median(abs_std_resid, na.rm = TRUE),
    p90_abs_std_resid = quantile(abs_std_resid, 0.9, na.rm = TRUE, names = FALSE),
    cells_abs_gt_2 = sum(abs_std_resid > 2, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 2)))
```

```{r}
#| label: map-standardised-residuals
#| echo: false
#| fig-width: 18
#| fig-height: 12
#| out-width: "100%"

residual_map_data <- msoa_boundaries |>
  left_join(standardised_residuals, by = "area_id")

std_resid_limit <- quantile(
  abs(standardised_residuals$std_resid),
  0.95,
  na.rm = TRUE,
  names = FALSE
)
if (!is.finite(std_resid_limit) || std_resid_limit == 0) {
  std_resid_limit <- 1
}
std_resid_limits <- c(-std_resid_limit, std_resid_limit)

method_levels <- levels(standardised_residuals$method)
wave_years <- sort(unique(standardised_residuals$time_id))

plot_standardised_residual <- function(method_name, wave) {
  plot_data <- residual_map_data |>
    filter(method == method_name, time_id == wave)

  residual_map <- plot_data |>
    ggplot() +
    geom_sf(aes(fill = std_resid), colour = "transparent") +
    scale_fill_distiller(
      palette = "RdBu",
      direction = -1,
      limits = std_resid_limits,
      oob = squish,
      labels = residual_label,
      na.value = missing_fill,
      name = "Std. residual"
    ) +
    ggtitle(wave) +
    theme_void() +
    map_text_theme

  if (wave == wave_years[1]) {
    residual_map <- residual_map + ylab(method_name)
  }

  if (!(method_name == method_levels[length(method_levels)] && wave == wave_years[length(wave_years)])) {
    residual_map <- residual_map + theme(legend.position = "none")
  }

  residual_map
}

residual_maps <- list()
for (method_name in method_levels) {
  for (wave in wave_years) {
    residual_maps[[length(residual_maps) + 1]] <- plot_standardised_residual(method_name, wave)
  }
}

wrap_plots(residual_maps, ncol = length(wave_years)) +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Standardised residuals by method and wave",
    subtitle = "Residual = (direct estimate - model estimate) / sqrt(direct variance + model variance)",
    theme = map_annotation_theme
  )
```
